subject: Kickstart: ACME MAP, risks & milestones — propose weekly checkpoints
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sara Dunn <sara.dunn@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Kickstart: ACME MAP, risks & milestones — propose weekly checkpoints

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the time last week. Per our conversation I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan for ACME focused on evaluation scope, success criteria, and a suggested cadence so we can hit your Q4 timeline. Draft is attached (ACME_MAP_v0.1.xlsx).

Proposed next steps / kickoff:
- Weekly 30-minute checkpoint (30 min) to review progress, blockers, and decisions
- Suggested day/time: Tuesdays 10:00–10:30 PT — flexible if you prefer another slot
- Initial success criteria to align on: 1) perf baseline (p99 latency < 250ms for median prompt set), 2) integration proof (end-to-end inference from staging), 3) security sign-off (DPA/SOC2 scoping completed)

I captured owners in the attached MAP but quick callouts:
- Redwood: Marcus Lin — evaluation cluster & access; Ben Carter — procurement/legal coordination; Naomi — MAP owner/schedule
- ACME: could you confirm the eng owner and procurement contact so I can update the sheet?

Could you confirm stakeholders and whether Tuesday 10am PT works? If good, I’ll send a recurring invite and update the MAP with milestone dates and owners.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0212

Attachment: ACME_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Sara Dunn <sara.dunn@acme.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: John Lee <john.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-09-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: ACME MAP, risks & milestones — propose weekly checkpoints

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the clear plan and the draft MAP. Tuesday 10am PT works for our team.

Joining: John Lee (VP Eng) will be the technical owner for the evaluation; I’ve CC’d procurement for contracting path. Two quick asks:
1) Can you attach a short SOC 2/DPA checklist (we need to know which artifacts you’ll provide during eval)?
2) We’d like a short demo in the first week of the MAP to validate latency expectations before we spin up test traffic.

I’ve created a recurring slot on our calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-weekly-map — please accept when you get it.

Date: 2026-09-02T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: ACME MAP, risks & milestones — propose weekly checkpoints

Perfect — thanks for the fast reply and for adding John & procurement. I accepted the calendar slot.

I’ve updated the MAP (see attached v0.2) with more explicit milestone dates and a short risk register. High level action items / owners I’m tracking for the first two weeks:
- Action: Provide evaluation cluster credentials and test dataset; Owner: Marcus Lin (Redwood); Due: 2026-09-10
- Action: Provide SOC 2 scoping doc + list of artifacts we can share; Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood); Due: 2026-09-08
- Action: ACME to confirm eng contact and share staging endpoint details; Owner: John Lee (ACME); Due: 2026-09-07
- Action: Schedule short demo for initial perf validation; Owner: Naomi Feldman; Due: 2026-09-09

Risks flagged: potential procurement lead time (mitigate by early DPA draft), variance on latency for long tail prompts (we’ll run focused perf tests week 1).

Please see my inline notes in the attached ACME_MAP_v0.2.xlsx. If any of the owners above should be different please reply inline and I’ll update the sheet.

Best,
Naomi

Attachment: ACME_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (updated MAP with milestones and risks)

Next steps from procurement side: I’ll review ACME’s procurement_form.pdf and send a DPA draft by 2026-09-08 so legal can start parallel review.
